LightningComponentBundle.description: EOI identity step page (split poster + UAE Pass / forms). Brand set per site in Experience Builder. Author: Aurelix

property.name: modonLogoImage
property.label: MODON logo URL
property.description: White MODON logo shown on the brand panel (left of the lockup on phones, above it on desktop); blank = none

property.name: caption
property.label: Trust line
property.description: Small caps line on the brand panel (e.g. location or trust marks)

property.name: wordmark
property.label: Wordmark text
property.description: Serif wordmark used when no logo image is set

property.name: projectId
property.label: Project Id
property.description: Project record id whose EOI ranges feed the residence step

property.name: typologyImageBase
property.label: Typology image base URL
property.description: Static-resource folder holding typology tile images (slug.jpg)

property.name: helpLine
property.label: Help line
property.description: Shown under Try again on the failed-payment screen (e.g. Need help? 800 MODON)

property.name: contactUrl
property.label: Contact URL
property.description: Contact our team link on the registrations-closed screen
